description: This file defines a lightweight core class for a game engine that handles the game loop using requestAnimationFrame. It manages updating game state, rendering to a canvas, and provides controls for starting, pausing, resuming, and stopping the engine. The class encapsulates the main functionalities needed for a real-time rendering loop in a browser environment.
external_files: - none explicitly referenced, though the code interacts with DOM Canvas context and window.requestAnimationFrame

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A lightweight, modular game engine controller that manages the game loop, including update and render calls, with pause, resume, and stop controls.

methods.name: constructor({ canvas, systems = {}, initialState = {}, maxDelta = 1 / 15 } = {})
methods.description: Initializes the Engine instance with optional canvas, systems, initial state, and maximum delta time.

methods.name: start()
methods.description: Begins the game loop execution, scheduling the first animation frame.

methods.name: pause()
methods.description: Pauses the game loop, canceling the scheduled animation frame.

methods.name: resume()
methods.description: Resumes the game loop from the paused state, scheduling animation frames again.

methods.name: stop()
methods.description: Stops the game loop and performs cleanup. Currently, it calls pause() to halt the loop.

methods.name: setState(patch)
methods.description: Atomically updates the internal game state with the provided patch object.

methods.name: _onFrame(ts)
methods.description: Internal method that is called on each animation frame to perform update and render calls, managing delta time calculation.
